title: Addressing Social Misattributions of Large Language Models: An HCXAI-based Approach
reasoning: The paper focuses on the ethical risks associated with how users misattribute social roles and personas to Large Language Models (LLMs), particularly in sensitive domains like mental health. It evaluates these risks from the perspective of epistemic injustice, unwarranted trust, and emotional manipulation, and proposes a framework for ethically responsible AI development.
